verdicts.reason: A is broken. Flavour names have lost their descriptors, which now sit in a separate list in the wrong order. Two of the cans are shrunk to tiny scraps in the bottom-left corner. The CTA is jammed into the top-left corner above the headline, and the text block is cramped with empty space below it. B is a faithful but shrunk copy of the original. Its content sits in the upper two-thirds with a large empty band at the bottom, and the descriptors, can labels and fine print are tiny; it rearranges nothing for the tall format.
